description: 23:30 - 00:00: Lined up to mud pumps. Increased flow gently to 400lpm, pumped totally 840ltrs. Pressure built up to 101 bar rapidly. Closed in well with SV. Estimated TOC between 3080 mmd 3110 mmd based on min/max displacement volume of 59,7/60,2 m3. Started monitoring pressure in XT cross from control room. Siwhp 27,5bar.
